name: NationMC Earth
description:
NationMC is a next-generation Earth SMP running on a custom 1:500 Earth world, where you and your friends can build real towns, unite into nations, and expand your influence across the globe. Choose a real-world location, claim your land, recruit allies, establish economies, and compete for global dominance.

We offer a high-polish Towny experience with tons of custom features, depth, and progression — all designed to keep you exploring, growing, and building your own history.
